# RouteGenie

> RouteGenie is a comprehensive NEMT (Non-Emergency Medical Transportation) software platform that automates scheduling, routing, dispatching, billing, and fleet management for medical transport providers.

RouteGenie serves NEMT providers across the United States with integrated solutions for managing trips, drivers, vehicles, and billing while maintaining Medicaid and HIPAA compliance. The platform integrates with major brokers like SafeRide Health, Modivcare, and MTM to streamline operations for medical transportation companies.

## Key Topics

- NEMT (Non-Emergency Medical Transportation)
- Route Optimization
- Dispatch Management
- Trip Scheduling
- Fleet Management
- Driver Management
- Real-time Tracking
- Billing & Claims (EDI, CMS 1500)
- Broker Integration
- HIPAA Compliance
- Medicaid Compliance
- Medical Transportation
- Trip Data Import
- GPS Navigation
- Cost Management

## Core Platform Features

- [NEMT Scheduling Software](https://routegenie.com/nemt-scheduling-software): RouteGenie automates scheduling, routing, dispatching and billing for NEMT
- [NEMT Routing Software](https://routegenie.com/nemt-routing-software): RouteGenie builds efficient routes optimizing gas and mileage for medical transport
- [NEMT Dispatch Software](https://routegenie.com/nemt-dispatch-software): RouteGenie dispatch software optimizes vehicle/driver selection with Medicaid compliance
- [NEMT Billing Software](https://routegenie.com/nemt-billing-software): BillingGenie sends claims electronically with EDI, CMS 1500, HIPAA compliance

## Management & Operations

- [NEMT Fleet Software](https://routegenie.com/nemt-fleet-software): RouteGenie fleet management tracks inspections, maintenance, vehicle operations
- [NEMT Management Software](https://routegenie.com/nemt-management-software): RouteGenie manages employees, payroll, drivers, licenses with HIPAA compliance
- [NEMT Broker Integration Software](https://routegenie.com/nemt-broker-integration-software): RouteGenie broker integration formats data for simplified transfer with MTM, Modivcare

## Mobile Applications

- [NEMT Driver App](https://routegenie.com/nemt-driver-app): RouteGenie driver app with GPS navigation, real-time tracking, dispatcher communication
- [NEMT Client Software App](https://routegenie.com/nemt-client-software-app): RouteGenie client app enables smartphone booking and real-time trip management
